  - /help — the built-in help screen; /config for settings, /model to switch model, /fast to toggle fast mode.
  - /clear starts a fresh context; --continue / --resume pick a session back up.
  - Slash commands come from built-ins plus skills in .claude/skills and plugins; typing / lists what's available.
  - !<command> at the prompt runs a shell command in-session so its output lands in the conversation.
  - Ctrl+C interrupts the current turn; /tasks shows background work.

  Runs until you close this session · For durable cloud-based loops, use /schedule
